title: SMP Purple PVP V1
description: A Vanilla Style PvP Texturepack for Many PvP Kits Crystal Sword Axe
body:
A Vanilla Style PvP Texturepack for Many PvP Kits,
Crystal; Sword; Axe

SMP Purple PvP
Retextures alot of PvP Based things like: Smaller Swords. Smaller Tools. Smaller Totems. Diffrent Mace Enchantment Textures.

A Texture Pack that changes the Tools and the End Crystals and Totems of Undying. Also Changes some Paintings.

Its meant for SMP pvp and Normal Multiplayer.
